construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Object containing schema_version=1, fixture={synthetic:true,label}, products, preferences and limit (1..50). Up to 200 products.
shared_schema.product: Unique trimmed id, nonempty name, category, unique tags, price={amount,currency:USD}; optional weight={value,unit:g|kg} and battery={value,unit:h|min}. Missing or null measurements are unknown.
shared_schema.preferences: interests maps category/tag tokens to positive weights; exclude_ids and exclude_tags are arrays; optional max_price_usd is inclusive; comparison_weights maps interest|price_usd|weight_g|battery_hours to nonnegative weights with positive total.
shared_schema.normalization: Category, tags, interest keys, exclusion tags and units are trimmed and casefolded. IDs are trimmed and case-sensitive. Canonical products use price_usd, weight_g, battery_hours; unknown measurements are null.
shared_schema.validation: One Validation layer handles required/unknown fields, types, booleans, finite/nonnegative numbers, units, duplicate identities/tokens, USD precision, canonical products and grounded interest handoffs. Numeric fields are bounded to 1e9 including canonical measurements. Duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite literals are rejected.
shared_schema.output: One JSON object: schema_version, status=ok, fixture, interests, comparison. Errors: schema_version, status=error, error; process exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated recommendation entries contain canonical product, interest_score, matched_interests and grounded explanations. Excluded products and eligible_count are also retained.
cross_stage_handoffs.invariant: Comparison consumes only the top-limit recommendations. The handoff is revalidated against the canonical context, including scores, source attributes, explanations, ordering and exclusions; tampered handoffs are rejected.

behavior.interest_ranking: Sum weights for distinct category/tag interest matches; a token matching both counts once. Rank descending score, then ascending product id. Nonmatching products remain eligible.
behavior.exclusions: Exact product ids, matching excluded tags and prices strictly above optional budget are excluded before ranking, with all applicable reasons.
behavior.comparison: Side-by-side rows expose canonical attributes for all selected candidates. Lower price/weight and higher battery/interest are preferred. Present values use candidate-local min-max utility. Equal present values receive utility 1; missing values receive utility 0. Final score is weighted mean rounded to six decimals.
behavior.ties: Comparison ties use descending interest_score then ascending product id. Ranks are sequential.
behavior.empty_results: Empty catalog or no eligible products succeeds with empty candidate/ranking arrays and empty side-by-side value maps.
behavior.grounding: Interest explanations cite matching source category/tag and preference weight. Comparison explanations cite source values, candidate ranges, utility and weight. No generated marketing claims.
behavior.determinism: No random, clock, network, provider or external state influences results.

included: Deterministic preference ranking and grounded explanations
Unit normalization, exclusion enforcement, missing-data policy
JSON CLI, file and validation error handling, unittest coverage
excluded: Live catalogs, networks, model providers and LLM calls
Currency exchange, arbitrary units and semantic interest inference
Persistence, authentication, UI and enterprise production operations
Global optimization across products outside the interest shortlist

test_outcomes.cli: Passed: one JSON object, status ok, exit 0
coverage: ID, tag and budget exclusions propagated into comparison
Weighted comparison scores and preference-driven winner changes
Missing measurements, ties, empty catalog and all-excluded results
Case normalization, distinct matches and inclusive budget
Invalid input subcases, duplicate JSON keys and malformed JSON
Deterministic ordering, input immutability and CLI success/error exits
